function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

Below is a **step‑by‑step playbook** you can follow to build a modern, production‑ready frontend for an e‑commerce site. Feel free to skip or reorder sections depending on your team’s skill set and project scope. --- ## 1️⃣ Planning & Requirements | Item | Why it matters | How to capture it | |------|----------------|-------------------| | **User personas** | Determines UI patterns (e.g., “quick‑add” vs. “detailed view”) | Interviews, surveys, analytics | | **Core flows** | Product list → detail → cart → checkout → order confirmation | User journey maps | | **Feature list** | Must‑have vs. nice‑to‑have | MoSCoW prioritization | | **Performance goals** | Page load < 2 s, 90 % Lighthouse score | Benchmarking, target metrics | | **Accessibility** | WCAG 2.1 AA compliance | Accessibility audit checklist | | **SEO** | Structured data, server‑side rendering | SEO audit, schema.org plan | | **Internationalization** | Multi‑currency, multi‑language | i18n strategy | | **Compliance** | GDPR, PCI‑DSS | Legal review | > **Tip:** Store all of this in a single living document (Google Docs, Notion, Confluence) so everyone stays aligned. --- ## 2️⃣ Design & Prototyping | Tool | Use case | |------|----------| | **Figma / Sketch** | Wireframes, high‑fidelity mockups | | **Storybook** | Component library + visual regression | | **Zeplin / Avocode** | Handoff specs to dev | | **Design System** | Reusable tokens (colors, spacing, typography) | **Deliverables:** - **Style guide** (tokens, typography, color palette) - **Component library** (buttons, cards, modals, etc.) - **Responsive breakpoints** (mobile, tablet, desktop) --- ## 3️⃣ Tech Stack Decision | Category | Options | Recommendation | |----------|---------|----------------| | **Framework** | React, Vue, Angular | **React** (most ecosystem) | | **SSR / SSG** | Next.js, Nuxt, Remix | **Next.js** (React + SSR + SSG) | | **State mgmt** | Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, React Query | **Redux Toolkit** + **React Query** for server state | | **Styling** | Tailwind CSS, Styled‑Components, Emotion | **Tailwind** (utility‑first, fast) | | **Component library** | Material‑UI, Chakra‑UI, Ant Design | **Chakra‑UI** (accessibility out‑of‑the‑box) | | **Testing** | Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress | **Jest + RTL** for unit, **Cypress** for E2E | | **Linting/Formatting** | ESLint, Prettier | **ESLint + Prettier** | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI | **GitHub Actions** (free for public repos) | | **Hosting** | Vercel, Netlify, AWS Amplify | **Vercel** (Next.js native) | | **Analytics** | Google Analytics, Plausible, Segment | **Google Analytics** + **Plausible** (privacy‑friendly) | | **Error Tracking** | Sentry, LogRocket | **Sentry** | > **Why Next.js?** > • Built‑in SSR/SSG → better SEO & performance > • File‑based routing → quick setup > • API routes → lightweight backend if needed --- ## 4️⃣ Project Skeleton (Next.js + Tailwind + Chakra) ``` my-ecommerce/ ├─ public/ │ ├─ images/ │ └─ favicon.ico ├─ src/ │ ├─ components/ │ │ ├─ ui/ # Buttons, inputs, modals │ │ ├─ layout/ # Header, Footer, Sidebar │ │ └─ product/ # ProductCard, ProductDetail │ ├─ pages/ │ │ ├─ _app.tsx │ │ ├─ index.tsx # Home / product listing │ │ ├─ product/[id].tsx │ │ ├─ cart.tsx │ │ ├─ checkout.tsx │ │ └─ api/ # API routes (optional) │ ├─ store/ # Redux Toolkit slices │ ├─ hooks/ # Custom hooks (useCart, useAuth) │ ├─ lib/ # API client, utilities │ ├─ styles/ # Tailwind config, global CSS │ └─ types/ # TypeScript interfaces ├─ .env.local ├─ tailwind.config.js ├─ postcss.config.js ├─ next.config.js ├─ package.json └─ README.md ``` --- ## 5️⃣ Core Features Implementation ### 5.1 Product Listing ```tsx // src/pages/index.tsx import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'; import { fetchProducts } from '@/lib/api'; export default function Home() { const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery(['products'], fetchProducts); if (isLoading) return

; return (
{data.map(product => ( ))}
); } ``` ### 5.2 Cart State ```ts // src/store/cartSlice.ts import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'; interface CartItem { id: string; quantity: number; } const cartSlice = createSlice({ name: 'cart', initialState: [] as CartItem[], reducers: { addToCart(state, action: PayloadAction) { const existing = state.find(item => item.id === action.payload.id); if (existing) existing.quantity += action.payload.quantity; else state.push(action.payload); }, removeFromCart(state, action: PayloadAction) { return state.filter(item => item.id !== action.payload); }, clearCart(state) { return []; }, }, }); export const { addToCart, removeFromCart, clearCart } = cartSlice.actions; export default cartSlice.reducer; ``` ### 5.3 Checkout Flow 1. **Address form** – use `react-hook-form` + Yup validation. 2. **Payment** – integrate Stripe Elements or PayPal SDK. 3. **Order confirmation** – show order summary, send webhook to backend. ### 5.4 Authentication - Use **NextAuth.js** (OAuth, email/password). - Protect `/checkout` route with `getServerSideProps` redirect if not authenticated. ### 5.5 Internationalization ```ts // next-i18next.config.js module.exports = { i18n: { locales: ['en', 'es', 'fr'], defaultLocale: 'en', }, }; ``` Wrap pages with `` components or use `useTranslation()` hook. --- ## 6️⃣ Performance Optimizations | Technique | How | |-----------|-----| | **Image Optimization** | `next/image` component, automatic resizing & WebP | | **Code Splitting** | Dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`) | | **Lazy Loading** | IntersectionObserver for off‑screen components | | **Prefetching** | `next/link` prefetch on hover | | **Caching** | SWR/React Query cache, HTTP cache headers | | **Critical CSS** | Tailwind purge + `@apply` for critical paths | | **Bundle Analysis** | `next-bundle-analyzer` plugin | Run `npm run lint && npm run build && npm run analyze` before each release. --- ## 7️⃣ Testing Strategy | Layer | Tool | Sample Test | |-------|------|-------------| | **Unit** | Jest + React Testing Library | Test `ProductCard` renders props correctly | | **Integration** | Cypress | Simulate adding to cart → checkout flow | | **Visual Regression** | Chromatic (Storybook) | Snapshot of `Button` component | | **Accessibility** | axe-core | Run `cy.checkA11y()` in Cypress | Add coverage thresholds in `jest.config.js` (e.g., 80 % statements). --- ## 8️⃣ Deployment Pipeline 1. **Push to GitHub** → GitHub Actions workflow: - Lint → Test → Build → Deploy to Vercel 2. **Environment variables** stored in Vercel dashboard (`NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY`, `DATABASE_URL`, etc.) 3. **Canary releases**: deploy preview branches automatically. 4. **Rollback**: Vercel’s built‑in rollback feature. --- ## 9️⃣ Monitoring & Analytics | Tool | Purpose | |------|---------| | **Sentry** | Real‑time error tracking | | **Lighthouse CI** | Automated performance checks | | **Google Analytics** | Traffic & conversion tracking | | **Plausible** | Privacy‑friendly analytics | | **LogRocket** | Session replay (optional) | Set up alerts for error thresholds (e.g., >5 errors/minute). --- ## 🔟 Maintenance Checklist | Task | Frequency | Owner | |------|-----------|-------| | **Dependency updates** | Weekly | DevOps | | **Security audits** | Monthly | Security Lead | | **Accessibility audit** | Quarterly | QA | | **SEO review** | Quarterly | Marketing | | **Feature backlog grooming** | Bi‑weekly | Product Manager | | **Performance regression tests** | After each release | QA | --- ## 📚 Resources & Further Reading | Topic | Link | |-------|------| | Next.js Docs | https://nextjs.org/docs | | Tailwind CSS Docs | https://tailwindcss.com/docs | | Chakra UI Docs | https://chakra-ui.com/docs | | React Query Docs | https://react-query.tanstack.com/ | | Stripe Checkout Integration | https://stripe.com/docs/payments/checkout | | Accessibility Checklist | https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.0 | | SEO for SPAs | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/seo-basics | | Lighthouse CI | https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci | --- ## 🎯 Quick Start Script ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-ecommerce --typescript cd my-ecommerce npm install @chakra-ui/react @emotion/react @emotion/styled framer-motion npm install tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p # Add ChakraProvider in _app.tsx # Configure Tailwind in tailwind.config.js # Add basic pages/components as per skeleton above ``` Run `npm run dev` and you’re ready to iterate! --- ### Final Thought Building a frontend for e‑commerce is a marathon, not a sprint. Start small (MVP: product list + cart), then iterate with real user feedback. Keep the codebase clean, test‑driven, and well‑documented—your future self (and your customers) will thank you. 🚀
